payload.title: Shipped repositioning: engine support (ship-054405)
payload.description:
As the Shipped owner, I want Papyrus to support the repositioning of Shipped from a board of verdicts to a living map (signals, the map, AI-written stories) steered by signed-in readers with an editor tier, so that Shipped can ship its engine-backed features on Papyrus rather than site-side workarounds.

Plan: AnthusAI/Shipped-web PR #53. Shipped engine epic: ship-054405 (Reposition 3: engine-backed features). Reader-facing parts on the Shipped side are blocked by the OAuth fix (ship-63b07d).

BUILD ORDER (stories are numbered in their titles and prioritised to match):
1. Weekly knowledge history archive (ship-09ea2c), M, urgent: cluster history cannot be backfilled.
2. Scheduled knowledge run in AWS (ship-09ea2c), L, BLOCKED on Ryan's approval.
3. Votes on any subject type (ship-15b04c), L.
4. Proposal record (ship-37026d), L; depends on 3.
5. Editor tier (ship-9890b5), L; depends on 3 and 4.
6. Model entity attributes (ship-87b02c), M; Proposals dependency for curated columns (4).
7. Trend story pipeline (ship-2fd025), XL; depends on 1, 4, 5.
8. Insight to concept promotion with lineage (ship-0be231), M; depends on 4 and 7.
9. AI-drafted sections of The Weekly (ship-b88e8c), M; depends on 7.

Definition of Done: every child story is closed, each behaviour change has passing Gherkin specs, and each feature is documented on the p.apyr.us product site.
Not included: a generic entity-grid block (deferred, YAGNI; Shipped builds its grid site-side first).
